text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Aston Villa and Manchester City at Villa Park!
Villa have made a flying start to the season, starting the day fourth in the table, with the opportunity to leapfrog today's opponents with a win here.
They've lost just one of their last 12 games in all competitions (W9 D2), prolonging that run by coming from behind twice to draw 2-2 with Bournemouth at the weekend.
They've struggled against City in recent times though, failing to win any of their last 13 Premier League games against them (D2 L11).
However, they're currently on a 13-match winning run at home, the longest such run in the division.
As for City, they're looking to keep pace with the top of the table, and after Arsenal's win yesterday, they can close the gap back to three points with a win here.

Pep Guardiola's side are unbeaten in their last nine matches in all competitions (W6 D3), but they've drawn their last three in the league, dropping leads in all of those games against Chelsea, Liverpool and Tottenham.
They've not had a winless run that long since 2017, and they'll be looking to get back to winning ways here.
There is just one change by Unai Emery from their draw with Bournemouth last time out.
Kamara is back from a ban, so he comes straight back in to sit in midfield.
Zaniolo drops to the bench.
Guardiola makes two changes to the side that drew with Spurs on Sunday, and they're both enforced.
Stones is back from injury to line up alongside Akanji in midfield, with Lewis also being brought in.
Jeremy Doku is injured, while Rodri is suspended along with Jack Grealish after both received their fifth bookings of the season in that game.
Nunes is back on the bench after passing a late fitness test.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Alvarez gets the game under way for City!
Kamara weaves away from Alvarez to set Villa on their way up the pitch and he tries to lift it over the top for Watkins to chase.
It's too close to Ederson though, and the keeper comes to collect it.
WIDE! McGinn does wonderfully to shake off Lewis and then Stones before poking it out to Digne as Alvarez comes up behind him.
The left-back's first touch takes him into space, but he blasts his shot into the side netting.

events.action: blasts his shot into the side net

text: SAVE! Villa are well on top in the opening exchanges here, and McGinn curls a superb early cross out to Bailey on the right.
He's got acres of space as he takes it into the box, but he can't get any power on the shot, which Ederson gets down to push wide.
GREAT SAVE! City can't clear their lines from the corner and McGinn takes it off Foden's toe on the edge of the box.
He tees up Torres, who stayed onside, and he curls a shot towards the far post, but Ederson gets a strong hand to it.
City's last four defeats have all come without Rodri featuring in the game at all.
Indeed, they're unbeaten in their last 43 games in which the Spaniard has played (W33 D10).
DOUBLE SAVE! Foden wriggles through a small gap before sliding it through to Haaland in the box.
He's one-on-one with Martinez, but his shot across goal is parried.
Silva clips it back to the Norweigan, who thumps a header on goal from close range, but the keeper gets behind that one too.
It's end-to-end stuff here at the moment as Villa mount their latest attack.
Dias does well to get in front of Bailey to stop him from bringing it down, and Stones is there to flick it away from Watkins, who was following in.
City are struggling to find space in midfield to pass their way forward, so Dias decides to go long this time, spotting Alvarez's run off the back of Carlos.
He sets off too early though, and the flag goes straight up.
It's Carlos who decides to lift one over the top this time, with Watkins getting in front of Dias to bring it down.
He tries to pick out McGinn in support, but the pass is too high, and it bounces awkwardly off the captain's hip.
It's a vital block from Kamara to stop Foden from getting through, but City just switch it out to Silva on the right.
He clips a good cross into the far post where Foden is now waiting, but he completely misses the ball on the volley.
City are starting to find their rhythm now as Walker goes for a big switch out to Foden.
He starts the move to help it back out to the right, and Stones trips over the ball before he can put a cross in.
GOOD SAVE! Konsa spots Bailey in a pocket of space through the middle, and he chooses to go it alone from range despite having options on either side.
It's a good hit, too, forcing Ederson to push it over with a strong hand.
Villa's first corner results in a quick second, and City only half-clear their lines once more.
It's worked out to McGinn on the edge of the D, but he curls his shot straight down the middle at Ederson.
Carlos' long ball forces Watkins out wide to the left this time, but he does well to hold off two City players.
He spins before trying to put a cross in only to hit it straight against Stones.
It's lovely footwork from Bailey, who leaves Stones in a bit of a twist as he tries to track him to the byline.
The Jamaican has two to aim for in the middle, but his cross is too deep for either of them.
CHANCE! Villa win a free-kick on the left, and McGinn is doing his best to put Ederson off as he hovers in front of the goalkeeper, much to his frustration.
Luiz clips it in as the Scotsman moves, and Konsa darts in to take his place, but thumps his header over the bar.
Akanji plays the reverse pass into Alvarez on the left of the box, and he fizzes a dangerous low cross into the middle for Haaland to attack.
Torres beats him to it, lifting it over his bar, but the flag was up anyway.
CHANCE! Villa work it brilliantly upfield, starting with Martinez all the way out to Digne on the left.
He squares his cross into the near post where Bailey makes a late run, but he blazes it over the bar.
WHAT A BLOCK! Ederson comes right off his line to play out from the back, and Gvardiol's pass deflects off Bailey, straight to Tielemans' feet.
He's setting himself to shoot and the Croatian slides in with a perfect tackle to make amends and stop him from picking out the back of the empty net.
City are looking very shaky at the back.
Moments after Gvardiol's pass was blocked, Walker plays a loose backpass to Ederson.
Watkins is hovering and just misses it.
Walker looks extremely relieved!
Digne and Walker collided as they both tried to win the ball back, and the Frenchman stays down holding his ribs.
He receives treatment but is quickly back up to continue.
Villa have already had 11 shots in this match, the joint-most by a team in the first half of a Premier League game against City under Guardiola.
Emery will be keen to turn those chances into goals soon though, especially while they're still on top.
Alavrez's heavy pass it cut out by Bailey, and he plays a one-two with Luiz to open up some space down the right.
It gets a bit crowded in the City box as the visitors flood back into their box and Konsa overhits the cross.
OVER! City don't look anything like their usual selves here as they sloppily keep giving the ball away in their own half.
Akanji is the latest to do so, gifting it to Luiz, but he blazes his long-range shot just over the bar.
To avoid having to work through Villa's aggressive midfield once more, Walker pings another good pass over the top.
Alvarez's first touch lets him down as he shows too much of it to Konsa, who clears the danger with ease.
Stones rushes in and clumsily bundles McGinn to the ground.
He's trying to protest his innocence, but he's shown the first booking of the game.
NO GOAL! Watkins is forced wide by McGinn's pass, but he still gets a shot away which Ederson smothers.
Villa keep it alive through Digne, who clips it into Luiz, and his header skims the inside of the post on the way in.
His celebrations are cut short by a flag, which is up because the ball went out of play before the cross was put in.
City are looking to score right on half-time as Silva picks out another good cross from the right.
Konsa attempts to clear it but completely misses the ball.
His movement was enough to put Foden off behind him though.
HALF-TIME: ASTON VILLA 0-0 MANCHESTER CITY.

It's goalless at the break between Villa and City, though how there haven't been any goals is anyone's guess! The hosts have been brilliant, keeping City under pressure, and forcing Ederson into some great saves to keep out Bailey, Torres, McGinn and Watkins.
Luiz thought he had broken the deadlock just before the break with a header that just crept in, but it was disallowed as the ball was out of play in the build-up.
At the other end, Martinez made an excellent double save to keep out Haaland, but those were City's only chances.
It was almost a perfect first-half performance by Villa, with only a goal missing to cap it off.
Emery will be urging them to keep up their high level as it's rattled City, causing them a lot of problems.
Guardiola's men made a lot of uncharacteristic mistakes, which is something the manager will be looking to rectify.
He may even look to his bench to add something different, especially since Villa comfortably won the battle in midfield.
Villa get us back under way for the second half!
City have dominated possession since the restart and they're looking to break Villa down early here.
They patiently work it out to the right, but Walker has a slight tug at Digne to lose him, resulting in a free-kick to the hosts.
Watkins intercepts Akanji's pass, sweeping it out to Digne on the left before continuing his run into the box.
The Frenchman tries to return it to him, but Dias gets in the way of the cross.
Villa haven't lost any of the 13 Premier League games under Emery that have been level at half-time, winning nine of those and drawing the other four.
Lewis gets a fistful of Luiz's shirt to stop him from breaking on the counter-attack and can have no complaints with the yellow card.
City work it forward in a couple of touches from Walker's throw-in, with Haaland threading it through to Foden.
He peels off the back of Carlos before firing on goal from a tight angle.
Martinez gets two hands behind it as a belated offside flag goes up.
It may have been City dominating possession, but Villa are intent on making the most of it when they do get the ball.
Bailey twists away from Gvardiol to square it to Luiz.
He's forced to rush his shot, and the deflection takes the power off it.
Bailey gets too tight to Gvardiol, giving away a free-kick in a good position on the left.
Silva swings a tempting cross into the six-yard box, but none of his team-mates get on the end of it.
Akanji drags the ball away from Watkins, who kicks him on the ankle as he misses it.
The Villa fans aren't happy as the yellow card is shown to their forward.
Luiz whips a good delivery in from the corner and it bounces awkwardly in front of Watkins, meaning he doesn't hit the volley cleanly.
Every City attempt at a clearance loops up into the air, keeping the pressure on until Dias hooks it away.
WIDE! Silva's first-time pass is loose as he plays out from the back and it's cut out by Watkins.
He touches it through to McGinn, who sees the space open up in front of him.
Ederson rushes out, so he curls it towards goal early, but it rolls agonisingly wide of the far post.
Villa are starting to find their rhythm again, and it's forcing City back deeper into their own box.
Kamara spins away from Lewis so he can switch it out to Digne, who squares it to McGinn, but his cross clears everyone.
The Villa fans are on their feet and the volume inside the stadium is rising as Bailey wins another corner with a deflected shot.
The delivery is poor by Luiz this time, but the visitors lose possession quickly again.
Guardiola has seen enough and is bringing on two midfielders in an attempt to give them a bit more control in the middle of the park.
Lewis is the first to go off, with Nunes replacing him.
And Kovacic is also coming on in place of Alvarez.
City haven't managed a shot in this game since Martinez was forced into a double save to deny Haaland in the 11th minute.
The Norweigan has struggled as well, having only 12 touches so far.
The City fans find their voice again to urge their team upfield.
Nunes listens to them, lifting a good cross towards Gvardiol at the far post, but his first touch takes the ball straight out of play.
Another change for City here as 20-year-old Bobb comes on to replace Foden.
BAILEY SCORES! Villa finally have their reward as they break the deadlock! Tielemans' touch wasn't great, but he got enough on it to help it to Bailey, who is just inside City's half.
He drives forward through the middle, weaving right then left to lose defenders.
He checks back on the edge of the D before taking aim, and a huge deflection off Dias takes it over Ederson.
1-0 Villa!
Tielemans was slightly off balance with Bobb tight to his back, but he made enough contact with the ball to help it through to Bailey.
City want a quick response to going behind, and they're back to dominating possession once more.
They're keeping it well up to the final third, which is where things just aren't going their way.
GREAT SAVE! City are all over the place at the back! Watkins pokes a shot on goal and Stones' block loops up into the air invitingly for Luiz.
Ederson had started to dive but recovers quickly to get across and smother the midfielder's chance at the far post.
Bailey stayed down after the scramble, but he's back on his feet after treatment.
Villa have a corner which is swung in by Digne, but Haaland is fouled as he clears his lines.
SAVE! Haaland draws a foul from Carlos and City have a free-kick down the left.
Silva takes it and whips a dangerous cross towards the near post.
Luckily for Villa, nobody gets a touch and Martinez can hold onto it.
Dias kicks Bailey on the calf as he wins the ball back, and the goalscorer goes down in a heap.
He needs to receive treatment again, and Emery might take him off this time just to be safe.
Villa are actually going to make a double change here.
Bailey is going off after receiving treatment, with Diaby on for him.
And Ramsey is making his return from an ankle injury as he replaces Tielemans.
OFF THE POST! The space opens up nicely for Luiz on the edge of the box, and he tries his luck from range once more.
Ederson is beaten by the curl, but it rattles the far post before bouncing back into play.
Kamara isn't happy that a foul has been awarded against him.
He goes into the book for dissent.
City take the free-kick quickly, with Akanji sliding it through to Dias, who is playing on the left wing at the moment.
He whips a cross in, but Martinez stretches to hold onto it.
Villa are making another double change as they look to see out this win.
Digne is the first to go off, with Moreno on in his place.
And there's a change up front too, as Duran comes on in place of Watkins.
City have only kept one clean sheet in their last nine Premier League matches (14 goals conceded), conceding in all five of their league games since the start of November.
City are getting desperate as their search for an equaliser goes on.
Stones put his laces through a clearance and it ends up being a good pass to Bobb.
He touches it into Kovacic, who dawdles instead of putting in a cross before tripping over the ball.
FULL-TIME: ASTON VILLA 1-0 MANCHESTER CITY.
Villa's winning run at home stretches to 14 games as they shone in a 1-0 victory over City.
It was a magnificent performance by Emery's man from start to finish, with City not knowing what hit them.

Villa had 13 shots alone in the first 45 minutes, the most against a Guardiola team in the first half of a match in Europe's big five leagues, with Ederson having to make big saves to keep his side in it.
Martinez also made a brilliant double save to deny Haaland, which were City's only shots in the whole match.
It took until the 74th minute for the deadlock to be broken, with Bailey's deflected shot wrongfooting Ederson.
Luiz also hit the post late on with a long-range strike.
It's a huge win for the Villains as it lifts them above City into third, and they have another big game at home against Arsenal on Saturday.
It's now four without a win in the league for City, who are six points off leaders Arsenal.
They travel to Luton Town at the weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
